final: WITH rental_by_rating AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS rental_count FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), total_rentals AS (SELECT SUM(rental_count) AS total FROM rental_by_rating), with_shares AS (SELECT rental_count, CAST(rental_count AS REAL) / (SELECT total FROM total_rentals) AS share FROM rental_by_rating), avg_share AS (SELECT 1.0 / 5.0 AS avg_share), filtered AS (SELECT * FROM with_shares WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share)) SELECT SUM(rental_count) AS total_count, SUM(share) / COUNT(*) AS average_share, SUM(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share)) / COUNT(*) AS average_excess FROM filtered
